statement.notes: The requested schema only includes the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. This value is directly provided as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the primary cash flow statement for all three years. No combination of elements is required. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide an alternative or additive breakdown for the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure reported on the cash flow statement.
